CustomField.description: Total Returned to Funder. Sum of Total Refunded across every Gift Commitment linked to this Opportunity - award money returned to the funder (unspent, disallowed, or clawed-back), tracked as Gift Refund records on the reimbursement transactions. Maintained by the DLRS roll-up Grant Total Returned to Funder. Visibility only: NPC is assumed to net refunds out of the commitment's paid total, so Total Received to Date and Running Balance already reflect them. Do not edit by hand. See docs/grant-reimbursement-rollups.md.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Award money returned to the funder to date, summed from Total Refunded on this grant's Gift Commitments. Calculated - do not edit.
CustomField.label: Total Returned to Funder
